unit: Unit · Could you please tell me where…?（礼貌问询与宾语从句）
title: The Castle Museum
intro: 这座古堡是一座大博物馆：骑士厅、金龙厅、王座厅、古塔、礼品店、邮局……这里的人都很讲礼貌。
问路要用礼貌的说法：“Could you please tell me where … is?” 先去庭院找导游格蕾丝：“Go to Ms Grace!”
patterns: Could you please tell me where the gift shop is?
Do you know when the castle was built?
Do you know where I can buy stamps?
Excuse me, could you please open the door?
Sure. It's next to the entrance, on the right.

things.name: museum sign
things.text:
Welcome to the Castle Museum
Open: 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.
Please do not touch the exhibits.
Could you please speak quietly?

things.name: castle map
things.text:
Castle Map
Restrooms: next to the entrance, on the left.
Gift shop: next to the entrance, on the right.
Knight Hall: on the left. Dragon Hall: on the right.
Throne Room: behind the great gate.

things.name: horse
chatter: Neigh! Excuse me, could you tell me where the carrots are?
Neigh! Do you know when my knight comes back?

things.name: knight armor
things.text:
The armor of Sir Leon.
He was a brave and kind knight.
He lived here about 400 years ago.

things.name: dragon statue
things.text:
This golden dragon was made in 1888.
People believed that dragons brought good luck,
so the king kept it in the great hall.

things.name: vase
things.text:
This blue and white vase is about 300 years old.
It came from China.

things.name: painting
things.text:
The Castle on the Hill
Painted in 1750.

things.name: owl
chatter: Hoo! Could you please tell me what time it is?
Hoo! Do you know where the post office is?

things.name: post office sign
things.text:
Post Office
Stamps, postcards and letters
Open every day, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.

npcs.name: Sir Bob
npcs.ouch: Ouch! That is not very polite, young wizard!
idle: Thank you for asking so politely!
Could you please speak quietly in the museum?
chatter: Excuse me, could you please speak quietly?
The Throne Room is behind this gate.
npcs.persona: Sir Bob, a polite castle guard at the great gate who only answers polite questions; grade-9 English
npcs.greet: Good day! Welcome to the Castle Museum. Please speak politely here.

npcs.name: Ms Grace
idle: Do you know when the castle was built? About four hundred years ago!
Please do not touch the exhibits.
chatter: Could you please follow me? The tour is starting!
The Knight Hall is on the left. The Dragon Hall is on the right.
Do you know who lived in this castle?
npcs.persona: Ms Grace, a friendly museum guide who knows the castle's history; grade-9 English with polite requests and indirect questions
npcs.greet: Hello! I'm Ms Grace, your guide today.

npcs.name: Mr Brown
chatter: Excuse me, do you know where the gift shop is?
I wonder where I can buy postcards.
npcs.persona: Mr Brown, a friendly tourist who is a little lost and not good with directions; grade-9 English
npcs.greet: Excuse me! Could you help me? I'm a little lost.

npcs.name: Lily
chatter: Excuse me, could you tell me where the restrooms are?
I wonder where the restrooms are...
npcs.persona: Lily, a young visitor who is looking for the restrooms; grade-9 English
npcs.greet: Hi! I'm Lily. This castle is so big!

npcs.name: Mr Page
idle: You can buy stamps at the post office.
chatter: Postcards! Toy castles! Could I help you find something?
You can buy stamps at the post office.
npcs.persona: Mr Page, the cheerful gift shop keeper; grade-9 English
npcs.greet: Welcome to the gift shop! Can I help you?

npcs.name: Sparky
idle: Excuse me, could you... Rawr! I am learning!
I want to be a polite dragon!
chatter: Where is the kitchen?! Oops... Could you tell me where the kitchen is?
I want to be a polite dragon!
npcs.persona: Sparky, a little dragon living in the old tower who wants to learn polite English; grade-9 English
npcs.greet: Rawr! I mean... hello! I'm Sparky, the little dragon of the old tower.

quests.titleZh: 听导游讲解，选出游客不能做的事
quests.title: Listen to the tour
intro: The tour is starting. Listen carefully!
done: Correct! Please do not touch the exhibits.
quests.audio: Welcome to the Castle Museum! This castle was built about four hundred years ago. If you look to your left, you will see the armor of a famous knight. You may take photos, but please do not touch the exhibits.

quests.titleZh: 格蕾丝想看骑士盔甲：带她去骑士厅
quests.title: Take Ms Grace to the knight armor
intro: Oh, I'm new here too! Could you show me where the knight armor is?
model: Follow me, please.
Go to the knight armor.
done: Here it is! Thank you. You are a wonderful guide!
quests.prompt: Please lead the way. I will follow you.
quests.tipZh: 骑士盔甲在左边（西边）的骑士厅。说“Go to the knight armor.”，格蕾丝会跟着你。

quests.titleZh: 用 Do you know … 礼貌地问城堡哪年建的
quests.title: Ask when it was built
intro: Do you have any questions about the castle?
model: Do you know when the castle was built?
Could you tell me when the castle was built?
done: Good question! It was built about four hundred years ago.
quests.prompt: Ask me when the castle was built, politely.
quests.judge: A polite indirect question about when the castle was built, e.g. 'Do you know when the castle was built?'
quests.tipZh: 礼貌地问：“Do you know when the castle was built?” 注意 when 后面用陈述句语序。

quests.titleZh: 参观结束啦！放烟花庆祝
quests.title: Fireworks show
intro: That is the end of our tour! Every evening the castle has a fireworks show. Could you start it for us?
model: Fireworks!
done: Wonderful! What a polite and clever wizard! Thank you for visiting the Castle Museum!

quests.titleZh: 读金龙的说明牌：国王为什么留着它？
quests.title: Read the plaque
done: Exactly. People believed dragons brought good luck.
quests.passage: This golden dragon was made in 1888. People believed that dragons brought good luck, so the king kept it in the great hall.
quests.prompt: Why did the king keep the dragon?
options: Because people believed it brought good luck

quests.titleZh: 读城堡地图：洗手间在哪里？
quests.title: Read the map
done: Right! The restrooms are next to the entrance, on the left.
quests.passage:
Castle Map
Restrooms: next to the entrance, on the left.
Gift shop: next to the entrance, on the right.
Knight Hall: on the left. Dragon Hall: on the right.
Throne Room: behind the great gate.
options: Next to the entrance, on the left

quests.titleZh: 礼貌地问守卫：礼品店在哪里？
quests.title: Ask politely
intro: Halt! In this castle you must ask politely. Ask me where the gift shop is.
model: Could you please tell me where the gift shop is?
done: Of course! The gift shop is next to the entrance, on the right. What a polite young wizard!
quests.tipZh: 守卫只回答有礼貌的问题。试试：“Could you please tell me where the gift shop is?”注意 where 后面是陈述句语序哦。

quests.title: Write it politely
intro: Now a writing test. Make this question polite.
model: Could you tell me where the restroom is?
done: Perfect word order! You may pass.
quests.prompt: "Where is the restroom?" → Could you tell me ___?
quests.judge: An indirect question with statement word order, e.g. 'Could you tell me where the restroom is?' (not 'where is the restroom').
quests.tipZh: 写：“Could you tell me where the restroom is?” is 要放到最后。

quests.titleZh: 用礼貌的咒语打开城堡大门
quests.title: Open the great gate
intro: The great gate is locked. Only a polite wizard can open it.
model: Please open the gate!
done: The gate is open! The Throne Room is behind it. Well done, polite wizard!
quests.tipZh: 礼貌地念咒语：“Please open the gate!”

quests.titleZh: 王冠失去了光彩：让它重新闪耀
quests.title: Make the crown shine
intro: The king's crown is in the Throne Room, but it has lost its shine. Could you please make it glow again?
model: Make the crown glow!
done: Look at it shine! The king would be very happy. Thank you!
quests.tipZh: 王冠在大门后面的王座厅。念咒语：“Make the crown glow!”

quests.titleZh: 告诉布朗先生礼品店在哪里
quests.title: Give directions
intro: Excuse me, could you tell me where the gift shop is?
model: Sure. It's next to the entrance, on the right.
It's over there, on the right.
done: On the right, next to the entrance. Thank you!
quests.prompt: Could you tell me where the gift shop is?
quests.judge: The child politely tells Mr Brown where the gift shop is or how to get there (e.g. 'Sure. It's next to the entrance, on the right.').
quests.tipZh: 布朗先生问礼品店在哪里。看看地图：“Sure. It's next to the entrance, on the right.”

quests.titleZh: 布朗先生不认路：带他去礼品店
quests.title: Take Mr Brown to the gift shop
intro: Sorry, could you show me the way? I'm not good with directions.
model: Follow me, please.
Go to the gift shop.
done: Here we are! Thank you so much. I can buy some postcards now.
quests.prompt: Could you show me the way, please?
quests.tipZh: 说“Go to the gift shop.”，布朗先生会跟着你走。

quests.titleZh: 礼貌地问店主：哪里可以买邮票？
quests.title: Ask about stamps
intro: Welcome to the gift shop! We have postcards and toy castles. But no stamps, sorry!
model: Do you know where I can buy stamps?
Could you tell me where I can buy stamps?
done: Stamps? You can buy them at the post office. It is behind the Dragon Hall.
quests.judge: A polite indirect question asking where to buy stamps, e.g. 'Do you know where I can buy stamps?'
quests.tipZh: 礼貌地问哪里能买邮票：“Do you know where I can buy stamps?”

quests.titleZh: 把明信片送给布朗先生
quests.title: Postcards for Mr Brown
intro: Oh! Mr Brown wants some postcards of the castle. Could you please give these postcards to him?
model: Pick up the postcards.
Give the postcards to Mr Brown.
done: Thank you, little wizard! Now Mr Brown can send them to his family.
quests.tipZh: 先拿明信片：“Pick up the postcards.” 再送过去：“Give the postcards to Mr Brown.”

quests.titleZh: Lily 找不到洗手间：带她去
quests.title: Take Lily to the restrooms
intro: Excuse me... I wonder where the restrooms are. Could you take me there, please?
model: Follow me, please.
Go to the restroom.
done: Here they are! Thank you so much!
quests.prompt: Could you take me to the restrooms?
quests.tipZh: 洗手间在入口旁边、左边（西边）。说“Go to the restroom.”，Lily 会跟着你。

quests.titleZh: 洗手间的门锁住了：礼貌地请它打开
quests.title: Open the door, please
intro: Oh no, the door is locked! Could you please open it?
model: Could you please open the door?
done: It opened! You are so polite — even the door listens to you!
quests.prompt: Say: Could you please open the door?
quests.tipZh: 礼貌地说：“Could you please open the door?”

quests.titleZh: 教小龙礼貌地问路：厨房在哪里？
quests.title: Teach Sparky to ask politely
intro: When I shout 'Where is the kitchen?!', people run away! How can I ask politely?
model: Excuse me, could you tell me where the kitchen is?
done: Excuse me, could you tell me where the kitchen is? Oh, that's much better! Thank you!
quests.judge: A polite indirect question asking where the kitchen is, e.g. 'Excuse me, could you tell me where the kitchen is?'
quests.tipZh: 教小龙说：“Excuse me, could you tell me where the kitchen is?”

quests.titleZh: 小龙的古塔太黑了：点亮古塔
quests.title: Light the tower
intro: My old tower is so dark at night. Could you please light it for me?
model: Light the tower!
done: Rawr! I mean... thank you very much! My tower looks beautiful!
